title: AE21003: Dynamics For Aerospace Engineers
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Reviews of the laws of motion, Dynamics of a particle in two or three
dimensions, equations of motion of an aircraft treated as a particle, Dynamics
of a system of particles, collision and orbit problems, rockets. Dynamics of
rigid bodies: kinematics of rigid bodies in two and three dimensions, equations
of motion and their solution for selected cases, equations of motion of a rigid
aircraft, gyroscopes, Introduction to the principle of virtual work and
Lagrangian mechanics. Books:I H Shames, Engineering Mechanics: Statics and
Dynamics, Prentice-HallJ L Meriam and L G Kraige, Engineering Mechanics:
Dynamics, John Wiley and SonsF P Beer and E R Johnston, Vector Mechanics for
Engineers â Statics and Dynamics, McGraw-Hill

Concepts taught in class

Dynamics of single particle and system of particles, Orbital mechanics, Rocket Dynamics
